title: Request a sales report guidance
text: Make a specific request, explain its purpose, and state an explicit deadline with a time zone. A polite question is one option; a clear, courteous direct request can also work.

title: Reschedule a client meeting guidance
text: Distinguish the original appointment from the proposed replacement. Preserve the exact date, time, and time zone. A proposed time is not confirmed until the recipient accepts.

title: Follow up on a proposal guidance
text: Identify the earlier message and ask for a specific next step without assuming the recipient has ignored you. Offer help and state a deadline when the scenario requires one.

title: Explain a delivery delay guidance
text: State the impact, give the known reason without blame, acknowledge the inconvenience, and provide a revised commitment and next update. Do not invent compensation or unsupported promises.

title: Clarify an ambiguous request guidance
text: Ask focused questions about unresolved details. Explain why the clarification is needed and avoid silently choosing a reporting period or scope.

title: Decline a request and offer an alternative guidance
text: State the boundary clearly and briefly explain the constraint. Offer only the support actually available and invite the recipient to respond. Excessive apologies are not required.

title: Review Request guidance
text: Identify the document, focus the review, give a deadline and explain how to return comments.

title: Meeting Invitation guidance
text: Explain the purpose, give the meeting time and location, and ask for attendance confirmation.

title: Status Update guidance
text: Distinguish completed work, remaining work and the next update without implying the project is finished.

title: Deadline Extension guidance
text: Acknowledge the original commitment, explain the constraint, propose a new date and ask for agreement.

title: Handover guidance
text: State the coverage period, where instructions are kept, the expected action and the escalation contact.

title: Access Request guidance
text: Ask for the minimum required permission, explain its business use and state when it is needed.

title: Invoice Clarification guidance
text: Identify the invoice and discrepancy precisely. Ask for clarification without assuming misconduct or promising payment.

title: Training Invitation guidance
text: State the topic, schedule, attendance location and required preparation. Ask for registration.

title: Incident Update guidance
text: Separate observed impact from investigation status, provide a workaround and commit to an update, not an unsupported recovery time.

title: Delivery Confirmation guidance
text: Confirm the item and quantity, state the delivery location, identify the receiving contact and ask for confirmation.

title: Feedback Request guidance
text: Name the activity, ask focused questions, explain how to respond and provide a deadline.

title: Approval Request guidance
text: Explain the proposal, state the spending ceiling, clarify that work is awaiting approval and request an explicit decision.
